whyos.summary: Live readings of the badge's environment and motion sensors
whyos.description:
Shows the BME680's temperature, humidity and pressure and the BMI270's
acceleration on all three axes, about once a second (the BME680 takes 0.6 s for its three values), with a graph
of the last 20 temperatures. The BME680 sits on the board, so it reads
warmer than the room.

The diamond key shows the help, the circle and clover the log and
settings screens, as in every app; Esc or the logo key closes it.
whyos.changelog: Its help opens and closes at once: the readings no longer redraw under it. It says it reads about once a second, as it does.

bundled.name: WhyOS SDK and libwb (the screens' drawing library)
